scope: All 34 newly flagged negative candidates from the 243-record favorable audits; all originally negative=False. The original 76 file is preserved; one documented amendment incorporates independently qualifying later evidence in 202600046.

original76_amendments.change: separate -> clear joint criticism, based on independent later paragraph283; conditional stupid sentence is not the primary basis

remaining_records_status: Were included in the favorable audit, but are not independently certified negative-free here. Do not interpret the 110 adjudicated records as a random sample or a complete negative denominator.

tier_definitions.clear: An asserted negative appraisal of Putin personally, or conduct/intent/capability unambiguously assigned to him. Explicit shared blame/capability judgments include him; clear does not mean harsh or exclusive.
tier_definitions.contextual: Putin or the two leaders are a plausible/explicit target, but negative appraisal, causal blame, or valence is implied or qualified enough to keep a separate sensitivity tier.
tier_definitions.separate: State/war/situation-only appraisal, unattributed attack criticism, request, conditional pressure, outcome-only disappointment, broad collective dismissal, or ambiguous actor attribution. These may be negative rhetoric but do not meet the actor-negative tiers.

key_corrections: March 7 Russia-bombing plus “can’t do that” is a request/conduct-context case, not an unqualified personal negative.
May 6’s literal negative object is “that war”; the question asks about Russian strikes, not a negative quality of Putin. Kept as state/war contextual disapproval, outside clear personal criticism.
October 20’s cut-it-out request alone would not qualify; an earlier passage independently blames the two leaders’ hatred for difficulty.
December 15’s country-level vacillation alone would not qualify; a later passage explicitly assigns difficulty to the two leaders’ dislike.
Bare descriptions of mutual hatred remain contextual; explicit claims that it obstructs talks/settlement count as mild joint criticism, consistently with existing 202600575.
praise_vs_criticism_winner: Not inferred. Favorable categories have different semantics and qualification layers; negative adjudication is candidate-based, and shared mild criticism is not equivalent to personal attacks.
